Here is a thorough map of the "owner identity" and identifier-derivation implementation in `/home/daniel/sandbox`. This is a Spring PetClinic variant; the owner-create pipeline lives under `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`. The DTO shape is defined in `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` (the `OwnerDto` Java class is generated at build time, so there is no committed source file for it).

Important upfront finding: There is currently NO `apiVersion` field, NO nested `identity` object, and NO audit-event `schemaVersion` anywhere in `src/main`. The only place those concepts appear is the acceptance test `AcceptanceTest.java`, which describes a target ("identity-v2") state the code does NOT yet satisfy. Details below.

---

## 1. Region-code derivation (used inside identifiers) + 3. locality / timezone

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/CityRegion.java`

This is the single source of region/locality/timezone derivation. Fixed closed tables:
- `CITY_REGION`: sydney→NSW, melbourne→VIC, brisbane→QLD
- `REGION_POSTCODES`: NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099
- `REGION_TIMEZONE`: NSW→Australia/Sydney, VIC→Australia/Melbourne, QLD→Australia/Brisbane
- `UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"` fallback locality

Key methods:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: An optional honorific for the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR). When
            supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When supplied
            (non-blank) it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input; it is normalized with the
            same rules as 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
